svg.text: Figure 4 - Clock domains and the CDC surface
Only two clock crossings exist in the whole design. That is a deliberate outcome of making the NHI synchronous.
dfi_clk IS clk_core - no crossing here
Pin rate 8 Gb/s -> CK = 2 GHz -> DFI ratio 1:2 -> core = 1 GHz.
One BL8 burst = 1 ns = exactly one core clock.
inside vendor IP - not your problem
No production-grade open-source CDC tool exists. A two-crossing design is reviewable by hand; a 512-crossing one is not.
